claims.claim: Of 13 frontmatter fields, only description is recommended; all others optional. name defaults to directory name if omitted.
claims.evidence: Official table; field.required = 'No' for all except description (Recommended).

claims.claim: name validation (Agent Skills API): max 64 chars, [a-z0-9-] only (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), no XML tags, reserved words 'anthropic' and 'claude' forbidden.
description validation: max 1024 chars per field (API), non-empty, no XML tags. Unicode allowed including emojis (but emoji discouraged for retrieval relevance).
Unofficial/emerging frontmatter fields observed in community: version (semver), license, mode. Not standard-enforced, ignored by Claude Code parser but useful for tooling.
argument-hint displays placeholder text in autocomplete (e.g., '[issue-number]'); has no functional effect beyond UX.
disable-model-invocation:true has dual effect: (a) removes skill description from system prompt saving ~100 tokens, (b) blocks automatic AND programmatic (Skill tool) invocation.
user-invocable:false only hides skill from / menu; auto-invocation and Skill tool remain functional; description stays in context.
claims.evidence: Quote: 'user-invocable field only controls menu visibility'.

claims.claim: allowed-tools accepts either space-separated string or YAML list; syntax supports tool-name only (Bash) or tool-name with pattern (Bash(git *)).
claims.evidence: Format examples in docs: 'Bash(git add *) Bash(git commit *)'.

claims.claim: model field overrides session model for skill invocation duration; accepts standard model IDs (e.g., claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5).
effort field accepts enum: low, medium, high, xhigh, max; overrides session effort level.
context:fork is the only supported value (no other fork modes documented); requires companion agent field to specify subagent type.
agent field accepts Explore, Plan, general-purpose (documented); community observes custom agent types may work if defined in ~/.claude/agents/.
Bug #17283 (Jan 2026): context:fork and agent fields are ignored when skill is invoked via Skill tool (programmatic). Only affects automatic/manual invocation correctly.
hooks field scopes hooks to a single skill invocation (see /en/hooks docs for hook events supported).
paths field accepts glob patterns; skill auto-loads only when Claude is editing files matching the globs.
shell field accepts bash (default) or powershell; powershell is Windows-only option.

Token overhead per skill disputed: Anthropic eng blog claims ~37 tokens/skill (from '40 skills = 1500 tokens' math), Lee Hanchung independent measurement reports ~100 tokens startup + ~1500 per turn (invocation).
claims.evidence: Anthropic eng blog + Lee Hanchung blog post triangulation.

claims.claim: Combinatorial frontmatter matrix: 2 (disable-model-invocation) x 2 (user-invocable) = 4 invocation states. State (true, false) = zombie skill unreachable via any path.
isMeta message injection: Claude Code injects skill content as message with isMeta flag, distinguishing skill-origin from user-origin content in conversation trace.
SDK differences: Claude Agent SDK does NOT support allowed-tools field; field is Claude Code-specific.
claims.evidence: SDK docs vs Claude Code docs comparison.

claims.claim: Frontmatter YAML parser is strict: rejects XML tags in any string field, rejects empty required-equivalent fields (description), case-sensitive boolean values (true/false lowercase).

conflicts_flagged.description: Token overhead per skill: Anthropic (37 tokens) vs Lee Hanchung (100 tokens startup + 1500 per turn). Possible explanation: 37 covers name+description metadata only; 1500/turn includes skill body after invocation.
Bug #17283 creates silent failure mode: skills designed for context:fork isolation work via slash command but lose isolation via Skill tool. No error message, just unexpected shared-context behavior.

gaps_flagged.description: No official frontmatter validator tool published; users rely on empirical testing to verify field interactions.
Missing schema definition for hooks field inside skill frontmatter vs global hooks config; unclear if same syntax applies.
Interaction of model field with session-level model override (e.g., /model command) not specified; which wins?

summary: R2 establishes complete frontmatter field matrix with validation rules, documents critical bug #17283 affecting context:fork via Skill tool, and resolves token overhead discrepancy via triangulation. Identifies zombie skill state (disable-model-invocation + user-invocable=false).
